segments.text: He is the protagonist's toxic friend #2 and Nami's blood-related older brother.
Hopelessly nerdy to the core, he is a multifaceted otaku who gets involved in everything, including eroge, cosplay, doujinshi, anime, tokusatsu and figurines.
He has next to no interest in real girls, save for her younger sister Nami whom he has the hots for (outdated term.)
* In reality she is his blood-related sister, so marriage is out of the question.

Nevertheless, he seems fond of over-the-top eroge-like situations and is truly a guy with sexual harassment in his nature. His nerdiness knows no bounds, and while he acts all highbrow, he does have an extreme masochist side to him. He keeps getting ridiculed by his young sister Nami, but keeps wild hope that it will one day turn into an immoral relationship, the kind that breaks EOCS regulations.
He has no intention of succeeding the family ryokan, instead he begs for allowance and focuses on hoarding goods. Yet strangely enough, he has a special personality that is hard to hate.
Translated from the official site

segments.text: Physique: Smooth and flat childlike form.
Hobbies: Reading shoujo manga (aimed at young teenagers) with passion and mail ordering (as there are no stores nearby, with focus primarily on cute accessories and clothes)
Skills: Karaoke and artistic gymnastics. Also jabbing her moron of a brother.
Weaknesses: Boredom and her mother (a ryokan hostess with an overbearing attitude, she's powerless before her.)
She is the protagonist's junior and a first-year student. She is Toshiaki's sister and also good friends with Jun and Shinobu.
Her family home is a resort ryokan run by her parents, located in Matsukawaooshima along her residence.
* Except for Yoshioka siblings, everyone lives in Futabajima.
Though sick of the hectic everyday of helping out with her parents' fairly popular place, she has never been to the mainland outside of school trips.
"One day, a prince will..."

She only dreams that someone takes her away from this island. Her brother Toshiaki is a typical otaku whose worthlessness further fuels her high ideals. Meanwhile, she seems to admire something about the relatively decent protagonist.
Translated in part from the official site and in part from Gyutto
Physique: Glamorously thick and large-breasted. Secretly planning for a diet.
Hobbies: Studying, relaxing in a bath. And secretly she has a weak spot for cute things.
Skills: Keeping things neat and tidy, invincible in games like Othello and shogi.
Weaknesses: Cooking in general, waking up due to her extremely low blood pressure (she is often half asleep.)
She is the protagonist's cousin, as well as his classmate, of the same age. Very serious and stubborn, she is the so-called strict class president type.

Her mother divorced her father when he got laid off as part of corporate downsizing. She got sent off to her grandfather's place in the Seto Inland Sea, for which she somewhat resents her parents. She used to do nothing but study in her earnest to become a bureaucrat in the future, but now she's completely out of it, stuck in a school on a peaceful island. She tends to blurt out ridicule towards the countryside, alienating her from those around her. Her grades are on the national level, but her stamina leaves much to be desired.
Far from having experienced romance, she hasn't even hung out with a boy in her private time before.
Her father is away from home, having been half-forced to get on an offshore fishing ship by the protagonist's father, her uncle.
Translated in part from the official site and in part from Gyutto
Physique: Quite well-proportioned, breasts are on the large side as well. Well-toned, so she appears slim.
Hobbies: Trying out sweet food and watching historical drama.
Skills: Cooking in general and sports in general.
Weaknesses: English and loanwords. Also she can't hold her liquor at all, she just gets trashed right away.
She is the protagonist's classmate and next-door neighbor. She is the caring older sister type, both dutiful and compassionate, the kind who prefers to get things done.

Her family of three also includes her fisherman father and her older sister Maki; her mother passed away when she was still a baby. She takes care of all housework in place of her older sister with no such talent.

Opening the window in the protagonist's room reveals a direct view of her room's window, so even the protagonist himself has come to somewhat accept that there's no getting away from this relationship.
She is the so-called mediator of the group who loves events. She holds the group's mood of "doing things together" dear above all.
Translated from Gyutto
Physique: Breasts are on the large side, yet she is quite slim. Appears to carry no extra weight besides her breasts.
Hobbies: Collecting cute accessories, handicrafts in general.
Skills: Laborous work. Also she's a hefty drinker who can hold her liquor.
Weaknesses: Anything requiring quick wits and swiftness, precision machines (she can't even schedule a video recording.)
She is the protagonist's classmate and also Shin'ichi's cousin. Her family are tangerine farmers as well as major landowners with ownership of a single mountain.

She has a calm demeanor but is nevertheless a hard worker who gives her all. She minds her manners and rarely loses her temper. What she lacks in agility, she makes up for in considerable endurance and strength. She can do anything as well as the average person, but only because of her daily efforts. She is the honor student type who stays clear of doing "bad things." She serves as a mediator who can gently make both pushy girls and frivolous guys alike settle down, one way or the other.
Translated from Gyutto
Physique: Huge breasts and a curvy figure of a western porn star.
Hobbies: Teasing her chaste students, drinking.
Skills: Turning anything into a dirty joke, giving blowjobs (self-proclaimed.)
Weaknesses: Working seriously.
She is a teacher at the protagonist's school and Jun's older sister. She is next-door neighbors with the protagonist.

An elite from a top university who has returned from Tokyo... and yet, she's actually quite a weirdo. Anyway, she seems to enjoy telling sexually charged dirty jokes to her students, almost as if she has an automatic "ero-speak translation function" attached to her. She can turn even a nonchalant everyday conversation into a dirty joke.
Rumor has it she never wears panties under her miniskirt, but no one has yet to confirm this.
Translated from Gyutto

Basically the typical protagonist. He generally finds things a hassle and has strong tendency to slack off. Acts cool, but is actually the caring type who sticks his nose into other people's business. He wants a girlfriend, but definitely enjoys mucking about with his buddies as well.

His family of four also includes his grandfather Genzaburou, his father Ryuuichirou and his mother Machiko. As of late, however, his father has been going offshore fishing frequently, so he is rarely home.
An ill-fated protagonist, for as he a relatively decent person, he finds himself treated as the plaything of his group.
Translated from the official site
He is the protagonist's toxic friend #1 and a cousin to Shinobu.
He is tall and good-looking, and so quite popular, but... he "wants to be everyone's Shin'ichi," thus won't get any girlfriend in particular.

Anyway, he has a playboy mentality and seems to quite seriously hold the idea that "all fine girls are mine." He too fell in love at first sight with Aoi who had transferred. He persistently professes his love to her over and over again.
He is quite skilled and able to perform any task you throw at him. He is a narcissist who is quite obsessed with living stylishly.
Her cousin Shinobu is actually the only one he wants to protect. In fact, the reason why he goes this far to act cool is due to him wanting to show off to her.
Translated from the official site
